warning.*.why: engine: StarWarning text is rendered in StarCore (StarWarning.swift) and reaches the desktop already localised through stard

severity.*.why: engine: composed into run_marker report text inside StarCore (RunMarker.swift), sent to the desktop as a StarWarning

run_marker.*.why: engine: RunMarker.asWarning builds the abandoned-run report in StarCore; stard sends it to the desktop (AbandonedRunReports.swift)

operation.*.why: gap: the progress line names the running operation via UpdatableProgressMonitor (gui only); the desktop's progress dialog never shows the operation name

progress.frames_in_*.why: gap: 'N frames in <state/operation>' progress suffix comes from UpdatableProgressMonitor (gui only); the desktop progress dialog lacks it
